Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: This step misinterpreted the truth/lie rule by rejecting the consistent all-vampire case and (incorrectly) allowing vampires to state a true sentence (“At least one of us is a human”), leading to the erroneous conclusion of 99. It is the loop entry with the core data misinterpretation; while not irrecoverable by itself, it set the reasoning on the wrong path and caused the downstream acceptance and termination of the incorrect answer.
